newsitem.title: USA: PageMart Wireless amends warrant terms.
newsitem.headline: PageMart Wireless amends warrant terms.

text.p: PageMart Wireless Inc said on Friday it amended the terms of some outstanding warrants so that their holders could exercise them on a cashless basis.
The warrants to purchase class A stock were issued in 1993 and can be exercised through 2003, the company said in a news release.

Their terms were amended to allow holders to have PageNet withhold from the shares issuable to them an amount with a fair market value equal to the exercise price. This allows the holders to "tack," or add, the holding period of the warrant to the holding period of the common shares received, for purposes of reselling the shares under Rule 144 of the Securities Act of 1933.
PageMart also said that on June 16 it will withdraw the registration statement it filed on December 19 regarding the reselling of Class A shares received upon exercise of the warrants.
The company said it advises warrant holders who want to sell under the registration statement rather than under Rule 144 that they must exercise the warrants and resell them before that date.
